title: Find large files
hints: Path(root).rglob("*") yields every path below root, directories included; keep only those where p.is_file().
p.stat().st_size is the size in bytes; p.suffix is the extension with its dot; p.relative_to(root).as_posix() is the display path.
Normalise suffixes once: lowercase, and prepend '.' unless it is already there or the string is empty.
One sort with key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]) gives size descending and path ascending together.
